 WWE AAA Lucha Libre results, live discussion (Oct. 17, 2026): Women’s champion La Catalina
 Follow along to watch the AAA women’s champion, a tag title bout, and more!
 by Manolo Has Pizzazz Oct 18, 2026, 1:00 AM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 Manolo Has Pizzazz learned all of life’s lessons from decades of professional wrestling. Manolo has been covering the sport for over ten years on Cageside Seats. AAA rolls on with another episode of lucha libre action on Saturday night (Oct. 17, 2026). The show features Reina de Reinas champion La Catalina in the house, the Wagner Brothers defending tag team gold, and more taped from Leon, Guanajuato, Mexico.
 Lucha Libre AAA airs Saturday night at 10 ET on FOX in Latin America as well as YouTube and Facebook everywhere else. WWE streams the show in English and AAA offers the program in Spanish in the live section of their respective YouTube channels.
 Join us for updates on results, click play above, and chat in the comments. If you’re on a mobile device, download the new SB Nation app , and follow along on your Feed or in the Game Chat section.
 WWE AAA LUCHA LIBRE RESULTS FOR OCTOBER 17 
 AAA Reina de Reinas champion La Catalina spoke about how winning the title wasn’t a dream. It is reality. Many doubted that she could achieve this success. Catalina is an example that dreams can come true. She wants to be the best and face the best. This is the beginning of Catalina’s story as champion. Enter Las Toxicas to interrupt. Flammer called Catalina’s win lucky. Flammer’s story isn’t finished, and she will get the title back. Catalina questioned why Flammer deserves a shot. La Hiedra is the only champion in the group. In all the years of friendship, Flammer never gave Hiedra an opportunity at the title. Catalina questioned which of them is actually the best. Maravilla cut Catalina off. Maravilla saw her plan of driving Flammer and Hiedra against one another. Las Toxicas are united. Catalina suggested that they speak with general manager Rey Mysterio to figure out who is the next challenger.
 Flammer went behind Hiedra’s back to chat with Rey. Flammer is better, and the title shot belongs to her. Rey will let her know about the title picture before the end of the night.
 Taurus defeated El Fiscal. The bull gained control with physicality. Fiscal rallied for a flying crossbody and an inverted leg lock. Taurus reached the ropes for the break. The bull charged forward, and Fiscal sent him head over heels on a back body drop. Taurus faked a knee injury on the landing. Abismo Negro Jr. ran in to attack Fiscal from behind. Taurus landed a running senton to win. Fiscal wants to fight Abismo to end this rivalry one and for all at Heroes Inmortales.
 Hierda told Rey that she is the best. Rey told her the same thing that he’ll make a decision by the end of the night.
 Rey’s decision was Catalina to defend in a three-way title bout with Flammer and Hiedra for Heroes Inmortales.
 AAA World Tag Team Championship: Wagner Brothers (c) defeated El Mesias & Mecha Wolf to retain the titles. The brothers put a pounding on the Puerto Ricans early. The challengers turned the tide by isolating El Hijo de Dr. Wagner Jr. Hot tag to Galeno running wild. Galeno and and Mesias threw blows spilling out of the ring. Galeno sidestepped, and Mesias crashed into the steel steps. Wagner got the upper hand on Mecha Wolf for the Wagner Driver. Wagner launched for a cannonball off the apron onto Mesias, and Galeno landed a frog splash on Mecha Wolf to win.
 Los Perros del Mal went to the ring to beat up the Wagners, but Mesias and Mecha Wolf pulled the Wagners out of the ring to continue that fight. La Parka, Mr. Iguana, and Niño Hamburguesa ran in to fight Los Perros to hype the trios title match at Heroes Inmortales.
 Lucha! Lucha! Lucha!
